# appwrite_health (Data Source)

Returns the Appwrite server health status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appwrite_health" "status" {}

output "server_status" {
  value = data.appwrite_health.status.status
}

output "server_ping" {
  value = data.appwrite_health.status.ping
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the service.
- `ping` (Number) Duration in milliseconds how long the health check took.
- `status` (String) Service status. Possible values are: pass, fail.
